title: BootstrapBundle
description: Immutable bundle loaded by a newly created host session during handoff. Contains shareable role knowledge only: no credentials, no private chat history, no model hidden state, no live tool handles. Created during handoffs.prepare; activation swaps the primary pointer only after the new session confirms the load.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version the bundle serializes; lets a second adapter validate compatibility on import.

source_generation.description: Generation whose knowledge this bundle carries. The successor becomes source_generation + 1.

source_knowledge_revision.description: Role knowledge_revision captured when the bundle was prepared. Activation fails with GENERATION_CONFLICT or REVISION_CONFLICT if the pointer or knowledge moved since.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the serialized checkpoint the bundle embeds.

provisioned_session_id.description: Host session created during handoffs.provision, recorded once the session confirms the bundle load.
